task.description: HARD GATE, RE-VALIDATION AFTER REWORK ITERATION 1. Your prior pass (see result below, now superseded) FAILed on one BLOCKER: SS4 wrongly cited Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_migrations/2 as taking a raw prefix string. CODE-DESIGNER's fix (commit 428f3fe) changed register_type/2, validate_payload/3, get_type/2 to take tenant_id and internally resolve schema_name via Repo.get_by(Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Registration, tenant_id: tenant_id), added :tenant_not_provisioned to all 3 error unions, and named Registration as a real SS6 dependency. Independently verify this fix directly against lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex and lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/registration.ex (read them yourself, don't trust the summary) -- confirm Registration is a real, correctly-named schema module with a tenant_id field, and that the new resolution steps in SS4.1/SS4.3 would actually compile-shape-match calling Repo.get_by that way. The JSON Schema library decision and no-new-decision-record call already passed independent verification last round and don't need re-litigating unless this rework touched them (it shouldn't have).
acceptance_criteria: priv/repo/migrations gains an event_type_registry migration (schema-per-tenant per REQ-022) applying cleanly
register_type/2 rejects a second registration with the same (name, schema_version) with a distinct, testable error, not a generic changeset failure
validate_payload/2 against a payload missing a required field returns a failure result whose detail names the specific field_path (JSON Pointer form) and constraint, not just a boolean false
get_type/1 against an unregistered name returns an explicit :unknown_event_type-shaped error rather than nil or an exception
the moduledoc names the JSON Schema validation library choice as an explicit open question for CODE-DESIGNER, not a silently made decision

result.summary: RE-VALIDATION after rework iteration 1 (commit 428f3fe). Read lib/letflow/design/req024-event-type-registry.md in full at its current HEAD state (not the prior draft, not CODE-DESIGNER's summary). Independently verified the fix against source, not against the design doc's own claims: (1) read lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/registration.ex directly -- Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Registration is a real Ecto schema (schema "tenant_schemas") with field(:tenant_id, Ecto.UUID) and field(:schema_name, :string), exactly the two fields the design's new Repo.get_by call and prefix: schema_name usage assume. (2) Read lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex directly -- replay_migrations/2 spans lines 153-181 exactly as cited; line 161 is `case Repo.get_by(Registration, tenant_id: tenant_id) do`, line 163 is `{:error, :tenant_not_provisioned}` on the nil branch, both citations in SS4's 'Correction' callout and SS6 are byte-accurate, not paraphrased-loosely. The design's new SS4.1 step 1 / SS4.3 step 1 (`Repo.get_by(Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Registration, tenant_id: tenant_id)`, nil -> {:error, :tenant_not_provisioned}, else bind schema_name for prefix: use) is the identical query shape, same field names, same struct, as replay_migrations/2's own inline lookup -- confirmed by direct comparison, not assumed. (3) Confirmed :tenant_not_provisioned is present in all three @spec error unions: register_type/2 (line 412-419), validate_payload/3 (line 504-510), get_type/2 (line 592-597) -- grepped each block directly, no function missing it. (4) Confirmed SS6 now names Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Registration as an explicit cross-module dependency (bolded 'genuine cross-module read dependency ... added in rework iteration 1', with accurate line-range citation into tenant_provisioning.ex). Re-ran the full Step 1b checklist (a-e) against the current document, not just the delta: every one of REQ-024's 5 acceptance criteria still maps to a concrete design element (AC1: SS3 migration spec, unchanged and still complete; AC2: SS4.1 register_type/2, full behavior steps 1-6 including the new tenant-resolution step, :duplicate_event_type_version and :schema_version_not_monotonic both distinct from generic changeset failure; AC3: SS4.2 validate_payload/3 + SS4.4 JsonSchema algorithm + SS4.5 ValidationFailure struct, field_path/constraint shape intact; AC4: SS4.3 get_type/2, :unknown_event_type on zero rows, never nil/raise; AC5: SS1/SS1.4, unchanged). No TBD/'to be implemented'/deferral language found (grepped the full file). All three reworked function specs have fully specified error unions with named atoms, not generic terms alone. No implementation code present -- grepped for code fences (14 found): all are either bare @spec blocks, the SS4.4 algorithm sketch (explicitly labeled 'not literal code -- ELIXIR-DEV writes the real version', pseudocode colon-syntax not valid Elixir), or the SS4.5 struct/@type shape (data-structure declaration, not a function body) -- none is a def/defmodule body. Diffed commit 0b3057f -> 428f3fe directly (git diff) to confirm the revision note's own claimed change scope is accurate: every hunk falls within the new revision-note paragraph, SS4's opening note, SS4.1-SS4.3, SS6, SS7.1's one-word terminology fix ('prefix threading' -> 'tenant-scope threading', consistent with the fix, not a substantive change), SS7.2, new SS7.3, and SS8 rows 2-4 -- SS1 (JSON Schema library decision), SS2, SS3 (migration shape), SS4.4/SS4.5 (validator algorithm/struct), and SS5 (Ecto schema) have zero diff hunks, confirming they are byte-for-byte unchanged from the already-PASSed prior round and do not need re-litigating. Cross-checked REQ-024's acceptance_criteria text directly in docs/requirements.yaml (lines 1034-1040) against both the handoff's task.acceptance_criteria and the design doc's SS8 traceability table -- all three copies match verbatim. The BLOCKER from the prior round is fully closed with no new problem introduced.
